nodes.title: Reliable first-day Assura adoption
nodes.description: Deliver the verified NU01-NU08 adoption fixes with the per-item acceptance criteria. This epic closes after its children have inspectable outcome evidence; it does not certify external pilot retention or a public release.

nodes.title: Expose configured nonblocking violations in Review and finding history
nodes.description:
Both real projects retain advisory=0 while Check names low findings; 501 to 700 lines produces no new/worsened Review finding. Assura has 13 nonblocking findings, but two optional baseline folders dominate actions.

Acceptance:
- A passing explicit low max_lines fixture emits a bounded named advisory and new/worsened/resolved history.
- Keep Review exit 0, Check severity exits, stable fingerprints, and honest overflow totals.
- Rank actionable configured violations ahead of optional setup suggestions.

Evidence: typescript-trial.md: baseline-mutation-review, python-trial.md: worsened-review, src/cli/project_review/report.rs:58-59
Related prior cards: R07, A06
Source: f3540d4a11d36afa43f69c96fd7f1c233599822a; reviewed release v0.4.1.

nodes.title: Preserve established agent policy when merging onboarding baseline
nodes.description:
Onboarding closes .agents and rejects existing .agents/project-policy.json; the same conflict appears on Assura own README.md. Bytes survive but policy intent conflicts before specialization. Assura self-onboarding also introduces inherited PascalCase errors in existing docs.

Acceptance:
- Reproduce existing .agents files and custom skill conventions in a disposable existing-project fixture.
- Preserve owner policy and deliberate closures; report unresolved merge constraints without adding an incompatible passing claim.
- Original files/hooks remain unchanged, repeated onboarding is idempotent, and generated policy passes or reports an actionable conflict.

Evidence: python-trial.md: onboard-first and onboard-baseline-check, self-onboard.json, self-doctor-after-onboard.json
Related prior cards: A02, A03
Source: f3540d4a11d36afa43f69c96fd7f1c233599822a; reviewed release v0.4.1.

nodes.title: Cover established application roots in generated native quality scopes
nodes.description:
Bun quality paths cover src/** and tests/** but miss actual Next.js app/, components/, lib/, hooks/, artifacts/. quality plan for app/(chat)/page.tsx selects only Assura while test edits select lint/test.

Acceptance:
- Next/Bun fixture changes in app/components/lib select applicable native lint/test phases.
- Generated and dependency outputs stay excluded; src-based projects still route correctly.
- Derive coverage from explicit evidence and preserve user-authored scopes on repeat onboarding.

Evidence: typescript-trial.md: quality-app, quality-test and onboard-auto
Related prior cards: A05, A03
Source: f3540d4a11d36afa43f69c96fd7f1c233599822a; reviewed release v0.4.1.

nodes.title: Make the Getting Started policy pass after its documented init step
nodes.description:
The exact Getting Started YAML rejects AGENTS.md generated by its preceding init --recipe agentic-core --recipe structure-health step. First check exits 1 on the minimal documented Rust project.

Acceptance:
- Execute published install/init/example/check in a disposable minimal project; clean example exits 0.
- Retain generated guidance and explicitly model its intended paths.
- Add an unexpected root file: Check exits nonzero; cleanup returns 0.

Evidence: docs-quickstart.json, website/src/content/docs/guides/getting-started.md: First Run
Related prior cards: Q02, W02
Source: f3540d4a11d36afa43f69c96fd7f1c233599822a; reviewed release v0.4.1.

nodes.title: Detect when installation leaves an older Assura first on PATH
nodes.description:
Native public installer passes checksum and reports success, but when old /usr/local/bin precedes the destination already on PATH, command -v assura still selects 0.4.0 after installing 0.4.1. No warning is printed in that case.

Acceptance:
- Seed old and new bin directories with old first and both present on PATH.
- Report the installed version and actual command resolution; if shadowed, provide a concrete correction without editing shell files or replacing another install.
- Verify both companions and a fresh-shell version canary after the documented correction.

Evidence: installer.json, installer-shadow.json, website/public/install.sh
Related prior cards: R05, R06
Source: f3540d4a11d36afa43f69c96fd7f1c233599822a; reviewed release v0.4.1.

nodes.title: Provide first-run recovery guidance for missing configuration
nodes.description:
check/review/doctor --format json before configuration exit 4 with empty stdout and a missing-config stderr, but no onboarding or init recovery command.

Acceptance:
- All three commands provide the applicable project path and a usable onboard/init next action.
- Preserve read-only diagnosis and documented nonzero exit behavior.
- Define and test whether JSON failures emit a structured error or a documented stderr contract.

Evidence: typescript-trial.md: doctor-before, review-before, check-before, python-trial.md: unconfigured-check
Related prior cards: Q07
Source: f3540d4a11d36afa43f69c96fd7f1c233599822a; reviewed release v0.4.1.

nodes.title: Make count violations identify offenders and actual limits
nodes.description:
Closed wildcard errors report only parent and count, including empty root path; custom folder-health messages replace actual/limit values with a documentation pointer.

Acceptance:
- Root and nested count failures name a deterministic bounded set of unmatched paths with omitted count.
- Actual count and configured threshold remain visible alongside custom guidance.
- Allowed patterns are excluded from offender lists and text/JSON/agent outputs agree.

Evidence: typescript-trial.md: closed-policy-count-allowance-mutations, python-trial.md: PY04
Related prior cards: Q07, A06
Source: f3540d4a11d36afa43f69c96fd7f1c233599822a; reviewed release v0.4.1.

nodes.title: Make starter source-health coverage explicit for Python and Rust
nodes.description:
Agent broad health lists md/js/jsx/ts/tsx but misses py/rs; plain init instead assumes Rust paths. A 501-line Python source stays silent while Markdown triggers health feedback. Naming and link rules work once deliberately configured.

Acceptance:
- Provide consistent supported source-health coverage or explicitly enumerate uncovered types with a supported specialization path.
- A Python monorepo source/test/generated fixture has a meaningful negative source-size proof.
- Avoid inventing language naming/layout policy from file presence and preserve project-owned rules.

Evidence: python-trial.md: minimal-config, explain-large-python and PY03
Related prior cards: A02, A03
Source: f3540d4a11d36afa43f69c96fd7f1c233599822a; reviewed release v0.4.1.

nodes.title: Triage current Assura nonblocking self-check debt
nodes.description:
Current source emits 13 nonblocking violations; 11 are in src. agent_nudge_delivery.rs has 1981 lines under a 500-line limit. Historical R07 done does not dispose of current violations.

Acceptance:
- Record every current violation with fix or evidence-backed scoped exception, owner and review date.
- Prefer cohesive repairs; avoid splitting only to game counts or broadly raising ceilings.
- Recheck exact current source and prove no unexplained advisory remains.

Evidence: self-check.json, self-review.json
Related prior cards: R07
Source: f3540d4a11d36afa43f69c96fd7f1c233599822a; reviewed release v0.4.1.

nodes.title: Enable a bounded local-link policy for Assura maintained docs
nodes.description:
A valid-frontmatter analysis doc with a deliberately missing local target emits no link finding under Assura current policy. Doctor truthfully says repository references are unchecked; 1116 raw candidates remain informational.

Acceptance:
- Select maintained documentation scopes and configure deterministic local file/anchor checks.
- A valid-frontmatter planted broken local target is found; cleanup passes.
- Classify generated/archive noise without globally promoting all raw reference candidates to blockers.

Evidence: self-link-controlled.json, self-doctor.json, self-review.json
Related prior cards: R07, P01
Source: f3540d4a11d36afa43f69c96fd7f1c233599822a; reviewed release v0.4.1.

nodes.title: Resolve the current-head many-scope performance gate failure
nodes.description:
Current master CI 37214120576 fails strict no-slower: 11.812ms Assura versus 11.650ms LS-Lint on many_configured_scopes_regression. Source regression versus variance is not established.

Acceptance:
- Inspect retained samples and compare an equivalent pinned baseline/candidate with bounded reproduction.
- Preserve the accepted fixture/threshold contract; do not retry unchanged until it passes or label noise without evidence.
- Record the smallest supported resolution and exact-head hosted gate outcome, including unfavorable results.

Evidence: master-ci-failure.txt, https://github.com/rothnic/assura/actions/runs/37214120576
Related prior cards: R02, R03
Source: f3540d4a11d36afa43f69c96fd7f1c233599822a; reviewed release v0.4.1.

nodes.title: Reconcile legacy delivery holds and workspace ownership
nodes.description:
The resource-safe topology audit found 46 prunable registrations, 15 unreadable worktrees and 18 unmerged goal branches. Starting this artifact task was held by old P05 integrated_pending_verification; absent paths and old receipts are not safe cleanup targets.

Acceptance:
- Classify each retained path/ref with live owner, source identity, evidence and next action.
- Resolve old P05 using actual acceptance/postmerge evidence or a named hold; do not rename an owner to bypass the guard.
- Remove only independently proven clean owned artifacts after a recoverable manifest; confirm terminal native status and rerun strict topology.

Evidence: topology-start.txt, task-start-hold.txt, prior-work-reconciliation.md
Related prior cards: none
Source: f3540d4a11d36afa43f69c96fd7f1c233599822a; reviewed release v0.4.1.
